tree.heading: Council.—
tree.text: The term “Council” means the Advisory Council on Historic Preservation.

tree.heading: Heritage tourism.—
tree.text: The term “heritage tourism” means the conduct of activities to attract and accommodate visitors to a site or area based on the unique or special aspects of the history, landscape (including trail systems), and culture of the site or area.

tree.heading: Program.—
tree.text: The term “program” means the Preserve America Program established under section 311102(a).
